title: RunningInstance
description: Identity + current recorded state of a live capability instance produced by an activation (CONNECT/DEPLOY/INSTANTIATE). Distinct from capability, software/artifact, offering and binding (CHP-CORE-021). Identity (id) is stable across status transitions (CHP-ENT-003 ethic); status is mutable state recorded about the instance; a transition appends a new record with the same id (history immutable).
